summary: Saint Teresa of Avila was a mystic and reformer whose life revealed the power of prayer and interior conversion. She remains a guide to contemplative courage.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Teresa of Avila as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Teresa of Avila, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
